# 236 Part II | Running the Show

After you have created your certificate signature, you may have some validation steps. Each step has a different method of validating and certificate information. If you require that features of incorporation, while require a company officer be made available to talk to a validation operator. At some point in the process you will be asked to copy and paste the contents of the CSR created by your signer's Web form.

```
$ cd /etc/httpd/conf/ssl.csr
$ cat-server.csr
--BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST--
MIIB/JCCBCIQECAQAwBgNJKo1ZIhvc0QQFAAADAY1TMRwEgY0DW1Q01E2Db25u5gWzW0N0N1
EMDbPEAMGAXm0W1XGT121MIJbG0WAYQOCXFB221111111YYYW5551111111111n11nM1EE11111YJZZZZZGGB3333333111111111

-- END CERTIFICATE REQUEST--
```

You can use your certificate to paste the CSR into your signer's Web form.

After you have completed the validation process, and for the signing, and answered all of the questions, you have completed the most of process. Within 72 hours you will receive an e-mail with your shiny SSL certificate in it. The certificate will look like:

```
--BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-
MIIJEFJCAQ+AgEAAAMBBIgJKw0hNAQEB0QFAAADAY1TMRwEgY0DW1Q01E2Db25u5gWzW0N0N1

```
